meta.note: Amazon listing style rules and limits used by the Stage 2 listing-agent skills. Approximate and dated — verify against your category's current Amazon style guide in Seller Central before publishing. Edit freely; skills read this file, nothing is hardcoded.

title.format: Brand + Product Type + Key Attributes + Size/Count + Top Differentiator
rules: Capitalize the first letter of each word; no ALL-CAPS words
Use numerals, not spelled-out numbers (2-Pack, not Two Pack)
No promotional language (sale, free shipping, hot item, deal)
No subjective claims (best, #1, top rated, premium quality)
Lead each bullet with a short capitalized benefit phrase
One benefit per bullet, backed by a concrete feature from the spec
No pricing, promotions, shipping, or seller/company information
Sentence fragments are fine; no closing punctuation required
Do not repeat words already present in the title or bullets
No competitor brand names, no ASINs
Lowercase, space-separated, no commas or quotation marks
Use singular or plural of a word, not both

always_banned: antibacterial or antimicrobial without EPA registration
eco-friendly / biodegradable without certification on file
needs_proof_on_file: UL listed / CE marked / FCC certified

rules: Never name, show, or disparage competitor brands; comparison charts compare against an unbranded 'standard' alternative or your own variants only
No pricing, promotion, shipping, or guarantee language anywhere in A+ content
No claims beyond those already cleared for the title and bullets
Every image's overlay text must also be provided as alt/keyword text (accessibility requirement)

main_image_rules: Product fills at least 85% of the frame
No props, text, logos, watermarks, badges, or graphics
Show exactly and only what is in the box
